LANGUAGES.LABEL: Languages
LANGUAGES.HINT: Set the languages available to the Players

ALIGNMENT.LABEL: Alignments
ALIGNMENT.HINT: Set the alignments of the game, and their correlation to {UOSE.ALIGNMENTS.LAWFUL}, {UOSE.ALIGNMENTS.NEUTRAL} and {UOSE.ALIGNMENTS.EVIL}

ADVANCED_CHARACTER_CREATION.LABEL: Advanced character creation
ADVANCED_CHARACTER_CREATION.HINT: Enables selection of race and class, instead of just class

MULTICLASS.LABEL: Multiclass
MULTICLASS.HINT: Allow for more than one class to be picked at character creation.

INDIVIDUAL_INITIATIVE.LABEL: Individual Initiative
INDIVIDUAL_INITIATIVE.HINT: Rolls initiative for each each actor instead of 1 for players and 1 for adversary group

ASCENDING_AC.LABEL: Ascending AC
ASCENDING_AC.HINT: Use ascending AC instead of Descending AC

ATTACK_ROLL_USING_THAC0.LABEL: Attack roll using Thac0 (instead of matrix)
ATTACK_ROLL_USING_THAC0.HINT: Adds the Thac0 bonus to the attack roll instead of consulting the Thac0 result matrix. Alters slightly the hit probability.

MORALE.LABEL: Morale
MORALE.HINT: Retainers and Adversaries roll morale on certain events.

ENCUMBRANCE.LABEL: Encumbrance
ENCUMBRANCE.SOURCE: Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome, Pg. 203; Carcass Crawler 2

ADD_STR_TO_ITEM_BASED_ENCUMBRANCE.LABEL: Add {UOSE.ATTRIBUTES.SHORT.STR} to Item Based Encumbrance
ADD_STR_TO_ITEM_BASED_ENCUMBRANCE.HINT: Adds extra slots to player inventory based on {UOSE.ATTRIBUTES.SHORT.STR} field

RELOAD.LABEL: Reload
RELOAD.HINT: Enforces reload on weapons with Reload tag

DAMAGE_PER_WEAPON.LABEL: Damage per weapon
DAMAGE_PER_WEAPON.HINT: Weapons deal damage described in weapon table instead of default 1d8 damage.

SECONDARY_SKILL.LABEL: Secondary Skill
SECONDARY_SKILL.HINT: Enables selection of Secondary Skills on Characters

WEAPON_PROFICIENCY.LABEL: Weapon Proficiency
WEAPON_PROFICIENCY.HINT: Player selects proficiency on available class and race weapons instead of having all of them, in exchange they get bonus to hit

REROLL_1_AND_2_ON_1ST_LEVEL_HD.LABEL: Reroll 1 and 2 on 1st level HD Rolls
REROLL_1_AND_2_ON_1ST_LEVEL_HD.HINT: On 1st level HD roll, reroll results of 1 and 2
REROLL_1_AND_2_ON_1ST_LEVEL_HD.SOURCE: Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome, Pg. 17 and 19

ALLOW_ILLUSIONIST_TO_WIELD_STAVES.LABEL: Allow Illusionists to wield staves
ALLOW_ILLUSIONIST_TO_WIELD_STAVES.HINT: Adds staves to the Illusionist class

ALLOW_MAGIC_USERS_TO_WIELD_STAVES.LABEL: Allow Magic Users to wield staves
ALLOW_MAGIC_USERS_TO_WIELD_STAVES.HINT: Adds staves to the Magic User class

IGNORE_RACE_CLASS_RESTRICTIONS.LABEL: Ignore race class restrictions
IGNORE_RACE_CLASS_RESTRICTIONS.HINT: Allows selection of any class, regardless of race restrictions. Only relevant if Advanced character creation is used

IGNORE_RACE_MAX_LEVEL_RESTRICTION.LABEL: Ignore race max level restrictions
IGNORE_RACE_MAX_LEVEL_RESTRICTION.HINT: Allows for all races to reach max class level. Only relevant if Advanced character creation is used

LIMIT_TURN_UNDEAD.LABEL: Limit turn Undead
LIMIT_TURN_UNDEAD.HINT: Adds limitations on use of Turn Undead for the cleric class

ADVANCED_SPELL_BOOK.LABEL: Advanced Spell Book
ADVANCED_SPELL_BOOK.HINT: Enables the Advanced Spell Book under the Character Sheet

VARIABLE_WIND_CONDITIONS.LABEL: Variable wind conditions
VARIABLE_WIND_CONDITIONS.HINT: Uses Variable Wind Conditions table instead of only having events on 2 and 12 in the 2d6 roll.

ATTACKING_WITH_TWO_WEAPONS.LABEL: Attacking with two weapons
ATTACKING_WITH_TWO_WEAPONS.HINT: Characters with {UOSE.ATTRIBUTES.SHORT.STR} and {UOSE.ATTRIBUTES.SHORT.DEX} as prime requisite may choose to wield a small size weapon on offhand making all attacks on main hand at -2, and allowing for one extra attack at -4 with the off-hand.

CHARGING_INTO_MELEE.LABEL: Charging into Melee
CHARGING_INTO_MELEE.HINT: Once per combat, a character may charge into melee and attack by moving at least 20 feet with no obstacles before the Attack. The attack is at +2 and AC is at -1. Weapons that can be braced agains charging monsters are also effective defense against this attack.

INVULNERABILITIES.LABEL: Invulnerabilities
INVULNERABILITIES.HINT: Allow monsters that can only be harmed by magical or silver weapons to be harmed by another monster with same attributes or a monster 5 HD higher than itself.

MISSILE_ATTACKS_ON_TARGETS_IN_MELEE.LABEL: Missile attacks on targets in melee
MISSILE_ATTACKS_ON_TARGETS_IN_MELEE.HINT: When firing into characters in melee the target is random between the participants of the engagement. Large creatures count as 2 and thus have higher chance of being targeted.

PARRYING.LABEL: Parrying
PARRYING.HINT: Characters with {UOSE.ATTRIBUTES.SHORT.STR} 13 or above can choose to act defensively forfeiting their attacks and add their bonus to melee to their AC as a bonus on that turn.

SPLASH_WEAPONS.LABEL: Splash Weapons
SPLASH_WEAPONS.HINT: Enables attack action on Items with Splash Tag, allowing them to deal damage in a small area.

SUBDUING.LABEL: Subduing
SUBDUING.HINT: Players can announce a subduing attack. Only blunt damage is allowed with exception of bladed weapons whose side of the blade can be used. Subdual damage is tracked separately, if an adversary reaches 0 HP due to subdual damage, it will surrender and realize that the opponent could have killed it.

THIEF_D6_SKILLS.LABEL: Thief d6 skills
THIEF_D6_SKILLS.HINT: Rolls Thief skills as D6 rolls instead of the original percentile die

COMBAT_TALENTS.LABEL: Combat talents
COMBAT_TALENTS.HINT: Allow for Fighters to pick combat talents at levels 1, 5 and 10

TREASURE_SHARE_XP.LABEL: Treasure share xp
TREASURE_SHARE_XP.HINT: XP awarded is no longer shared between all members of party, but decided based on gp value of items and gold shares, plus equal shares of defeated monsters.

CANTRIPS.LABEL: Cantrips
CANTRIPS.HINT: Enable Cantrips for dedicated spell casters.

SPECIAL_MATERIALS.LABEL: Special Materials
SPECIAL_MATERIALS.HINT: Adds weaker and Enhanced materials for armor and weapons.
